cards.text: This is a psalm of David, king of Israel, and friend, it's short but it is LOADED. David tells us what the LORD said to someone David calls my Lord. And what the LORD says puts Him in the highest place of honor there is.

cards.question: The LORD speaks to the one David calls my Lord. What does the LORD tell Him to do?

answers.text: Go out ahead of My army

cards.question: While David's Lord sits at the LORD's right hand, the LORD says that He Himself will make the enemies of David's Lord a footstool.

cards.text: Those enemies end up as a footstool for His feet, and Jesus quotes this very line (Matthew 22:44).
Next, the LORD extends the mighty scepter of David's Lord from Zion, the City of David (2 Samuel 5:7). And friend, that scepter is NOT there for decoration.

cards.question: The LORD extends the mighty scepter of David's Lord from Zion. What does He say along with it?

answers.text: Rule in the midst of Your enemies
Make peace with all Your enemies
Go back and wait in Your tent

cards.text: From Zion the LORD tells Him, “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.” Then David turns to His people on His day of battle.

cards.question: On the day of battle for David's Lord, His people have to be dragged into the fight.

cards.text: WILLING, friend, and that is HUGE, because you ask the group chat who can help move a couch and suddenly everybody's phone is dead. Then David paints it in big pictures: holy splendor, the womb of the dawn, the dew of Your youth.
Now the LORD does something big, friend: He swears an oath. Not a pinky promise. Not a "we'll see." An OATH.

cards.question: The LORD swears an oath to David's Lord but leaves room to change His mind later.
The LORD swears that David's Lord is a ___ forever in the order of Melchizedek.

cards.text: A priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High (Genesis 14:18). Hebrews says Jesus has become a high priest forever in that same order (Hebrews 6:20).
Next, David says the Lord is at Your right hand. And a day of wrath is coming.

cards.question: David says the Lord is at Your right hand. In the day of His wrath, He will crush ___.
David says the One who crushes kings in the day of His wrath will also judge the nations.

cards.text: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead, and crush the leaders far and wide. Then the psalm ends on a quiet picture: He drinks from the brook by the road.

cards.question: In the psalm's last line, He drinks from the brook by the road. What does the psalm say He will do because of that?
